content:
Start Here. Start Easy. For more than 20 years, SHINING 3D has been advancing high-precision 3D digitization, building deep technical expertise and a solid foundation in precision metrology. Through EINSTAR, this professional 3D technology has now entered a more accessible space—bringing trusted scanning capabilities closer to makers, 3D printing enthusiasts, and everyday creators. That commitment now takes shape in EINSTAR EZ GO—the first AI-powered mobile 3D scanner. Combining wireless mobile scanning, versatile laser and infrared technologies, and AI-powered tracking and assistance, EZ GO makes 3D scanning easier to start and easier to use. Scanning is only the beginning. With cloud-powered 3D Gaussian Splatting processing and seamless integration with the SHINING 3D software ecosystem, including ShiningSpace, EXModel, and EXMeasure, EZ GO helps turn real-world objects into digital assets and digital ideas into creations.
